recommendations.description: Initiate a claims-processing and auth-to-claim validation audit for Medicaid inpatient AUTH_CODE_DISTRIBUTION claims in FL, CA, IN, MD, and MO and LTSS Dual Eligible IA claims with facility_type 'Not Mapped'; verify denial enforcement, confirm authorizations match actual admissions, and reprocess mismatched Riley's Children's Health and affected neurologic, back, delivery, and Depressive Neuroses claims to contractual standards before any UM, reimbursement, or network action.
evidence: FL, CA, and IN/MD/MO show AUTH_CODE_DISTRIBUTION shifts requiring validation before action.
IA LTSS Dual Eligible spend includes facility_type 'Not Mapped' and no-auth claims.
RILEY'S CHILDREN'S HEALTH is flagged in IN under the same authorization pattern.
Impacted DRGs include neurologic, back, delivery, and Depressive Neuroses inpatient cases.

recommendations.description: Implement enhanced prior-authorization and high-volume provider audit policy under existing Florida Medicaid rules for SNF - FREE STANDING admissions in LTSS Dual Eligible and LTSS Non Dual, with diagnosis-focused review for Degenerative Nervous System Disorders with MCC and Medical Back Problems without MCC.
evidence: FL LTSS Dual Eligible free-standing SNF paid rose by $58.2M.
Admissions increased by 6,568 in FL LTSS Dual Eligible SNFs.
FL LTSS Non Dual free-standing SNF paid rose by $8.1M.
Medical Back Problems without MCC added $1.1M with mixed volume-unit cost.

recommendations.description: Conduct a CA provider-level utilization management audit for NF and SNF - FREE STANDING admissions that enforces prior-authorization and auth-to-claim matching, and reviews discharge-pathway and site-of-care decisions for LTSS Dual Eligible, LTSS Non Dual, and TANF Standard cases tied to HEMIPLG FLW CEREB INFARCT LT N-DOM, HEMIPLG FLW CEREBRAL INFARCT RT DOM, SPINAL STENOSIS LUMBAR REGION NO NC, and ALZHEIMERS DISEASE UNSPECIFIED.
evidence: CA NF growth centers on stroke sequelae, spinal stenosis, Parkinson disease, and Alzheimer's disease.
Free-standing SNF growth spans LTSS Dual Eligible, LTSS Non Dual, and TANF Standard.
Admissions increased while paid per admit was flat or down.
Operational cards include pa_required_code Y and auth_dimension_present.
Recommended next step targets post-acute placement and provider discharge pathways.

recommendations.description: Initiate a Tampa General Hospital FL Medicaid inpatient contract-compliance, prior-authorization, and level-of-care/site-of-care audit for prior-authorized acute admissions, prioritizing ABD Non Dual and TANF Standard cases and NICU neonatal DRG Extreme Immaturity or Respiratory Distress Syndrome, Neonate, and confirm claims process per contract.
evidence: FL ABD Non Dual acute hospitals added about $5.9M with 422 more admissions.
ABD Non Dual paid per admit at Tampa General increased about $9.9K.
Tampa General TANF Standard acute-hospital cases added about $336K.
Tampa General NICU concentration added about $547K across 3 admissions.

recommendations.description: Open a RILEY'S CHILDREN'S HEALTH review for IN Medicaid CHILDRENS TANF Standard and Family Care to audit prior-authorization enforcement, admission and outlier service-line mix, and claims processing against reimbursement terms, with site-of-care or contract remediation where indicated.
evidence: RILEY'S CHILDREN'S HEALTH is the main IN provider concentration.
TANF Standard and Family Care both show repeated delta concentration.
Admissions and paid per admit increased at RILEY'S CHILDREN'S HEALTH.
Both source cards have pa_required_code Y and auth-to-claim validation.

recommendations.description: Open a focused NC Medicaid inpatient behavioral health review for ACUTE PSYCH/TANF Foster Care episodes, starting with Central Regional Hospital, to audit initial and concurrent review KPIs, discharge-planning controls, and contract-compliant claims processing for POST-TRAUMATIC STRESS DISORDER UNS, ADJUST D/O W/MIXED DISTURB EMOTIONS, and REACTION TO SEVERE STRESS UNS.
evidence: NC TANF Foster Care acute psych shows admissions up and paid per admit up.
PTSD and adjustment disorder drive concentrated IP BH inpatient growth.
Central Regional Hospital appears in drill context on key NC IP BH cards.
Rare stress and OCD cases show small-N volatility and need validation.

recommendations.description: Conduct a focused Medicaid acute-hospital maternity authorization and reimbursement review for DRG "Vaginal Delivery with O.R. Procedures Except Sterilization and/or D&C" in MD, IN, NY, KS, and MO to confirm prior authorization was obtained, authorization denials were enforced, actual services matched authorizations, authorized level matched paid level, and claims processed per contractual reimbursement terms, with targeted review of MD diagnoses POST-TERM PREGNANCY, SEVERE PRE-ECLAMPSIA COMPLICATNG CB, and FT PROM ONSET LABR W/I 24 HR RUPT.
evidence: Recurring driver: Vaginal Delivery with O.R. Procedures across MD, IN, NY, KS, MO.
Operational groups show pa_required_code Y and auth_dimension_present.
MD diagnoses concentrate in POST-TERM PREGNANCY and SEVERE PRE-ECLAMPSIA COMPLICATNG CB.
IN is unit-cost-led with higher average paid per admit.
Admissions increased in affected Medicaid delivery episodes.
